title.narrative: USAID Uhuru - TB & FP LON Facility

description.narrative: (Tanzania): With FY 2022 funds, USAID will support local partners in Tanzania to implement an integrated approach to health service delivery at health facility levels, particularly for TB and FP programming. Specifically, UHURU will integrate FP and TB service delivery in public, private, and faith-based health facilities and their surrounding communities in the regions of Katavi, Kigoma, Rukwa, and Songwe. This activity will collaborate with community partners in these regions to ensure continuous care and linkages between the health facilities and supported communities. Additionally, UHURU will address challenges relating to TB case detection, TB screening, and preventive measures. Specifically, the focus will be to increase the use of molecular TB diagnosis through supporting efforts to improve logistics and coordination of specimen referral and monitoring of preventive maintenance of TB laboratory equipment. On the FP side, it will address challenges in programming including high rates of teenage pregnancy, low contraceptives rate, and high unmet needs of family planning among women of reproductive age and youth.
